name: open-news
description: open-news is a Python library for news discovery and extraction. It fetches live news via DuckDuckGo, searches Google News, discovers RSS feeds, crawls websites, and extracts article text. Features filtering, deduplication, ranking, and optional JavaScript rendering. Includes Python API, CLI, and terminal UI.
readme_summary: open-news is a Python library designed for discovering, extracting, filtering, and summarizing news content from various online sources. It provides functionalities to fetch live news, search Google News, discover RSS feeds, crawl websites, and extract article text, offering both a Python API and a command-line interface.
key_features: Google News Search (query modes, exclusions, domain lists)
Website Discovery (RSS auto-discovery, async crawler, JS crawler)
primary_use_case: To programmatically discover, extract, and process news articles from the web, enabling applications like news aggregators, content analysis tools, and research platforms.
cover_image_prompt: A curious librarian standing at a grand central information desk, holding a magnifying glass over a swirling vortex of digital news feeds. The vortex is composed of glowing headlines and article snippets, representing raw online news. The librarian is pointing their magnifying glass towards a specific, clear article emerging from the vortex, symbolizing extraction and filtering. Subtle UI elements showing search queries and extracted metadata float around the desk. The background is a warm, inviting library setting with shelves of books subtly morphing into data servers. The overall mood is one of organized discovery and clarity. The style should be a 3D isometric illustration with a clean, modern aesthetic and a vibrant, informative color palette.

name: mimik
description: 🪄 A browser extension that captures your workflow as you click and turns it into a step-by-step guide with annotated screenshots 📸
readme_summary: Mimik is a browser extension that automatically records user workflows, capturing clicks, keystrokes, and navigation to generate step-by-step guides with annotated screenshots. It prioritizes privacy with a local-first, no-account, no-tracking approach.
key_features: Auto-capture of browser workflows (clicks, keystrokes, navigation)
Automatic generation of step-by-step guides with annotated screenshots
Smart blur for sensitive data (emails, SSNs, credit cards, etc.)
Manual blur picker for custom elements
Local-first, privacy-focused operation (no account, no cloud, no tracking)
primary_use_case: Creating documentation, tutorials, and onboarding guides for browser-based tasks and workflows.
cover_image_prompt: A friendly, anthropomorphic 'guidebook' character with a magnifying glass and a camera lens for eyes, actively observing and capturing a series of digital footprints left by a user's mouse cursor on a stylized browser window. As the character captures each footprint, it instantly transforms into a small, annotated screenshot that neatly stacks into a growing, organized tutorial. Subtle glowing lines connect the captured footprints to the generated screenshots, and the repository name 'Mimik' is subtly integrated into the character's design or a small plaque nearby. The scene is bright and clean, rendered in a 3D isometric illustration style with a focus on clarity and a friendly color palette.

name: NextSteamGame
description: A Search engine Based of Simularity, Utlizing a Hierarchy Genre Umbrella system with vector simularity
readme_summary: NextSteamGame is a Python project that builds a game recommendation engine based on semantic similarity and game identity rather than solely player overlap. It processes game metadata and reviews to extract detailed features, creating a richer understanding of why games are similar.
key_features: LLM-based feature extraction (focus vectors, identity metadata)
FastAPI + React frontend with Postgres backend
primary_use_case: To provide game recommendations that explain the reasoning behind the similarity, focusing on intrinsic game characteristics rather than just player behavior.
cover_image_prompt: A wise old librarian meticulously organizing a vast, glowing library where each book represents a video game. Instead of just shelving by genre, the librarian is carefully placing books based on intricate, glowing threads connecting them, representing shared mechanics, narrative themes, and unique 'vibes'. Some threads are thick and vibrant (core similarities), while others are delicate and colorful (niche anchors). In the background, subtle holographic displays show semantic vectors and identity tags. The library itself is a blend of old-world charm and futuristic data visualization. The overall mood is one of deep understanding and discovery, with the repository name 'NextSteamGame' subtly etched on a nearby desk. Style: 3D isometric illustration with a warm, inviting color palette and ethereal lighting.

name: proxelar
description: Scriptable local traffic workbench for inspecting, intercepting, replaying, and rewriting HTTP/HTTPS and WebSocket traffic.
readme_summary: Proxelar is a Rust-based MITM proxy designed for developers to inspect, intercept, rewrite, and replay HTTP, HTTPS, and WebSocket traffic locally. It offers multiple interfaces including a TUI, a web GUI, and a REST API, along with powerful Lua scripting capabilities for traffic manipulation.
key_features: HTTPS Man-in-the-Middle with local CA generation
Multiple interfaces: TUI, Web GUI, REST API, CLI
Support for HTTP/1, HTTP/2, and feature-gated HTTP/3
Portable session saving/loading and import/export (HAR, curl, raw)
Rules for URL mapping, mocking, and redirection
primary_use_case: Debugging and manipulating local HTTP, HTTPS, and WebSocket traffic for API development, application testing, and network analysis.
cover_image_prompt: A skilled artisan, dressed in a modern workshop apron, meticulously examining and reshaping streams of digital data flowing from various devices (laptop, phone) into a central workbench labeled 'Proxelar'. The streams are visually distinct, some glowing with intercepted information, others being subtly altered by the artisan's tools. Small, transparent screens around the artisan show snippets of code and network logs. The overall mood is one of focused control and transformation, with a clean, bright aesthetic. The style should be a 3D isometric illustration with a focus on clear iconography and a slightly futuristic feel.

name: uncover
description: Quickly discover exposed hosts on the internet using multiple search engines.
readme_summary: Uncover is a Go-based command-line tool designed to efficiently discover exposed hosts on the internet by querying multiple search engines. It's built for automation, allowing seamless integration into existing security and reconnaissance pipelines.
key_features: Support for Shodan, Censys, FOFA, Hunter, Quake, ZoomEye, Netlas, CriminalIP, PublicWWW, HunterHow, Google, Onyphe, Driftnet, DayDayMap, NerdyData
stdin/stdout support for input and output
primary_use_case: Automated discovery of internet-exposed hosts using various search engine APIs for reconnaissance and security auditing.
cover_image_prompt: A digital cartographer meticulously drawing a vast, interconnected network map on a glowing holographic globe. The cartographer uses a specialized magnifying glass that reveals hidden digital pathways and 'exposed' points on the globe, which are highlighted with bright, pulsating nodes. Small data streams flow from various search engine icons (like Shodan, Censys, Google) towards the cartographer's tools, symbolizing the data sources. The overall mood is one of focused discovery and expansive digital exploration, rendered in a clean, 3D isometric illustration style with a futuristic, tech-inspired color palette.

name: Lemuroid
description: All in one emulator on Android!
readme_summary: Lemuroid is an open-source Android emulator based on Libretro, designed for ease of use and a great user experience. It supports a wide range of classic gaming consoles and offers features like automatic state saving, ROM scanning, and customizable controls.
key_features: Wide system support (Atari, Nintendo, Sega, PlayStation, PSP, NDS, 3DS, Arcade)
primary_use_case: Emulating classic video game consoles on Android devices.
cover_image_prompt: A vibrant, stylized illustration of a magical portal opening in the center of a modern Android smartphone screen. Through the portal, classic video game characters and landscapes from various retro consoles (NES, SNES, Genesis, PS1, N64) are spilling out, rendered in a playful, energetic style. The smartphone itself has subtle glowing UI elements around the edges, indicating its role as the gateway. Digital particles and a soft glow emanate from the portal, symbolizing the emulation process. The background is a clean, slightly blurred representation of a living room or gaming setup. The overall mood is nostalgic and exciting, with a bright, inviting color palette. The style should be a 3D isometric illustration with clean lines and a focus on clear visual storytelling.
